name: Redesign the addon create/edit flow so each tab is its own form
description:
## Decision (2026-08-31)

The single-form structure was raised in the review of PR #43343. Decision taken there:

- Epic [CZ3TDR1-559](https://teamdotblue.atlassian.net/browse/CZ3TDR1-559) stays a pure technical rewrite — Smarty → React/Inertia at 1:1 parity. No functional rewrite, no redesign of the flow.

- The question is valid but does block rewrite. A UX review and design phase up front would have blocked the rewrite; the per-tab tickets proceed as planned.

- The ?legacyTab= bridge and the ui-tab-external escape hatch are an accepted temporary workaround, removed by CZ3TDR1-571 at cutover.

- The structural fix — one tab = one form, no data persistency between tabs — is expected to land in the new Partner portal, not as a retrofit of the current page. This ticket produces the design for it.

## Why?

PartnerServiceAdd is the page every API partner uses to create and edit a Shoptet addon. It is currently 11 jQuery-UI tabs wrapped in a single <form id="main-form">, all served by one controller. Data "persists between tabs" only in the sense that every tab's inputs are simultaneously present in one giant DOM form, and one Save writes all of them at once.

This came out of the code review on [PR #43343](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/pull/43343). The reviewer asked why this page can't use the ordinary React tab pattern (e.g. ContactInformationGeneral, where 2 of 3 tabs are React and the third is still Smarty, with no special handling). Answer: it can't, because there each tab is its own controller and its own pathname, so the router resolves each tab independently. PartnerServiceAdd has one pathname for all 11 tabs. The preferred method for creating tab content is as follows: We do not create tabs that are intended to retain data when the user clicks on a different tab. Each tab should function as a separate form.

## 
What?

A UX review of the whole addon creation and editing flow, end to end, resulting in a design where each tab is a self-contained, independently savable form, wizard or other approach.

Scope of the review:

1. Walk the current flow — create a new addon and edit an existing one, all 11 tabs: Nastavení, Popis, Screenshoty, Endpointy, Kódy, Uživatelé, Testovací instalace, Marketing, Přehled novinek, Doprava, Hodnocení. Note where the single-form structure hurts the partner.
2. Design the target flow — one tab = one form = one save. Tab switching is navigation, not a hash toggle.
3. Answer the questions the split forces (these are the actual design decisions, not implementation details):

  - Create vs. edit. You cannot save tab 5 of an addon that doesn't exist yet. Does creation become a short first step (minimum required fields) that produces a draft addon, after which all tabs become independently editable? Or a guided wizard?
  - Unsaved changes. What happens when a user edits a tab and clicks another tab — block, prompt, autosave, or discard?
  - Cross-tab required fields. Submitting an addon for approval requires fields spread across several tabs. Where does that completeness check live and how is "what's still missing" communicated?
  - Draft / incomplete state. Is a half-filled addon a visible state with its own affordances?
  - Save affordances. Today: Uložit / Uložit a odejít / Zpět in one page header for all tabs. What replaces that per tab?
  - Edit lock. Currently one lock over the whole record. Per-tab, or unchanged?
  - Tab strip vs. other navigation. Confirm tabs are still the right pattern for 11 sections, or propose an alternative (sidebar, grouped sections, wizard).
4. Deliver designs/wireframes for the target flow plus a written summary of the decisions above, at a level the API team can turn into implementation tickets under CZ3TDR1-559.

## Definition of Done

[ ] No form spans multiple tabs. One tab = one form. Each tab is submitted and saved on its own, and no tab's save writes or depends on fields owned by another tab — i.e. no data persistency between tabs.

[ ] The create flow is designed and answers how the first save happens before an addon record exists.

[ ] The unsaved-changes behaviour on tab switch is specified.

[ ] The completeness / submit-for-approval check across sections is specified (where it lives, how missing items are surfaced).

[ ] Save/back affordances are specified per tab.

[ ] Designs cover both create and edit, and all 11 tabs (or an explicit rationale for any tab left as-is).

[ ] Reviewed with the API team (owner of section-map row 1081, serviceTeam='api') and the CZ3TDR1-559 implementer; agreement that the design is implementable within the ongoing React/Inertia rewrite.

[ ] Follow-up implementation tickets created under CZ3TDR1-559, or CZ3TDR1-559's per-tab tickets updated to match the new structure.

- Reference for the target shape (one tab = one route = one form): admin/react/src/Core/pages/ContactInformationGeneral/page.tsx
- Legacy: admin/controllers/PartnerServiceAddController.php, admin/controllers/templates/PartnerServiceAdd.tpl, admin/controllers/templates/sub/ServiceDetail/
